The Evening

Coffee, chrome & couture — all in one night

Cars and Cafe's celebration turns our drive-in arena into an open-air runway — exclusively for women. Participants walk between a showcase of vintage classics, superbikes and modified cars, with the café serving its full menu through the evening. Entry is completely free.

Every participant walks two main rounds, gets a professional photo portfolio shot at the car showcase, and a certificate. Finalists return for the Grand Finale round and a short Q&A with the judges before the crowns are announced under the string lights.

  • Round 1 Introduction Walk — your signature style, western or fusion
  • Round 2 Retro Wheels — vintage-inspired looks matched to the classic cars
  • Round 3 Grand Finale — evening glamour + judges' Q&A (finalists only)

Show Day

Sunday, 6 December — the running order

Participants report at 3:00 PM sharp. Audience gates open at 4:00 PM — entry is free for everyone, café seating is first-come.

  • 3:00 PM

    Reporting & bib allotment

    Check in at the registration desk, collect your participant bib and goodie kit.

  • 3:30 PM

    Grooming touch-ups & runway rehearsal

    Backstage styling support and a full walk-through rehearsal with the choreographer.

  • 4:00 PM

  • 6:00 PM

    Vintage-inspired looks matched to the classic cars on display.

    Crowns, trophies and cash prizes — followed by photos with the winners at the car showcase.

  • 9:15 PM

    DJ & celebration dinner counters

    The night closes with music, dinner counters and the café's dessert bar.

Good to know

Rules of the runway

Simple, fair and family-friendly — for women participants only.

  • This edition is open to women aged 18 and above only; carry a photo ID on show day.
  • Entry is completely free — there is no registration or participation fee at any stage.
  • Outfits for both main rounds — plus an evening-glamour outfit if you are shortlisted for the finale — are arranged by the participant; backstage changing rooms and styling support are provided.
  • Costumes must be family-friendly — the show is an all-ages café event.
  • Judging: walk & confidence 40%, styling 30%, stage presence 20%, Q&A 10% (finalists).
  • The judges' decision is final. Cash prizes are paid by bank transfer within 7 working days.
  • If the event is postponed or cancelled, all confirmed participants will be informed on WhatsApp.
  • Reporting after 3:30 PM may move you to the waitlist — please be on time.

Questions

Before you ask

I've never walked a runway. Can I still join?

Absolutely — most of our participants are first-timers. The 3:30 PM rehearsal and grooming session on show day covers walk basics, poses and stage cues, and our choreographer walks every category through their rounds before the show starts.

Do I arrange my own outfits and makeup?

Outfits for the two main rounds are yours to arrange — that's where your personal style scores. Shortlisted finalists also bring an evening-glamour outfit for the finale. Backstage changing rooms, mirrors and a styling support team for touch-ups are provided free on show day.

Can family and friends watch?

Yes — audience entry is completely free. Gates open at 4:00 PM with the car and bike showcase, and the café serves its full menu all evening. Seating is first-come, so arriving early helps.

How and when are prizes paid?

Winners are announced at 8:45 PM on show night. Cash prizes are transferred to the winner's bank account within 7 working days; crowns, trophies and hampers are handed over on stage.

Is it really free? And who can enter?

Yes — entry is completely free for participants and for the audience. This edition is women only (ages 18+), capped at 60 participants. Once slots fill, new entries join the waitlist and are offered places in order if anyone withdraws.

What if the show fills up?

The women-only runway is capped at 60 slots. Once full, new entries join the waitlist and are offered slots in order if anyone withdraws — register early to secure your place.
